INSERT INTO dataset_key_blocks (dataset_id,
                                 block_ref_name,
                                 event_type,
                                 sequence_number,
                                 block_hash_bin,
                                 block_payload)
            SELECT $1,
                   $2,
                   value ->> 'event_type',
                   value ->> 'sequence_number',
                   unhex(value ->> 'block_hash_bin'),
                   unhex(value ->> 'block_payload')
            FROM json_each($3)
